title: Idempotent Command Receipt
intent: Make retried commands return the same committed result without duplicate effects.
problem: Without idempotency key maps to a fingerprinted stored receipt, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the idempotent command receipt contract.
context: This pattern addresses clients retry commands after network ambiguity; its concrete control is idempotency key maps to a fingerprinted stored receipt.
forces: Correctness requires that same key and payload returns one result
Operational pressure can cause: receipt persistence follows the side effect
solution: Implement idempotency key maps to a fingerprinted stored receipt. Verify the anchored symbol `TaskKind` with `test_arkaon_can_claim_delegated_research_build_test_and_audit_work` before reuse.
invariants: same key and payload returns one result
same key with different payload is rejected
failure_modes: receipt persistence follows the side effect
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `receipt persistence follows the side effect` and fails closed if the idempotent command receipt evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For idempotent command receipt, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to idempotency key maps to a fingerprinted stored receipt.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: clients retry commands after network ambiguity
Do not apply when: every invocation is intentionally a distinct event
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: clients retry commands after network ambiguity
not_when: every invocation is intentionally a distinct event
